mapper.select:
SELECT h.*, o.name AS owner_name FROM house h LEFT JOIN owner o ON h.owner_id = o.id
AND h.building LIKE CONCAT('%', #{building}, '%')
AND h.status = #{status}
ORDER BY h.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO house (building, unit, room_number, area, house_type, owner_id, status) VALUES (#{building}, #{unit}, #{roomNumber}, #{area}, #{houseType}, #{ownerId}, #{status})
